test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters L, Z, I, D, N and A. Two positions of the same dice are given below. Which face is opposite to face N?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0e52b7b6913df934d52bc9f20d768fbf1a7fbde77fe89b841d060ddab6cc5b0.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As A is common on both the dice, it is clear that D, L, Z, and I are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. N will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/901c107a645791fbc96a47ecde8ddae4c0461652f8a908621b6d40369b3fe529.png] 

Opposite pairs:

D → I

L → Z

A → N

So, the opposite side of "A" will be side "N".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
